label: AI Insight UI — Analytics
info:
Analytics backend per FAP §10. Provides:
  - Synthesised /history endpoints the simulation flow doesn't yet expose
    (/api/v1/{meters,pv,weather}/:id/history) — 24h hourly readings derived
    from time-of-day. The original Trends/Correlations/Anomalies views were
    deleted in bdeb538 because these endpoints 404'd; with this flow they work.
  - FAP §9 actions for analytics aggregations:
      analytics.trends         (params: metric, range)
      analytics.correlations   (params: metricA, metricB)
      analytics.anomalies      (params: metric, range)
      analytics.recommendations

The synthesizers are placeholder — replace with Trino queries against silver/
gold once the corresponding /history feeds land in the simulation engine.
